name: a08_sword
title: Inase: greatsword strikes
note: a08's own strikes with her greatsword in her right hand (user 10-06: "动作有拿巨剑的普通攻击么，给inase拿着长剑的找一些普通攻击，可以看roe中是否有现成的，或者Universal Fighting Engine 2 Source v2.7.0a 里是否有"). Neither has any: Rise of Eros has no normal attacks (each outfit: stance, three skills, hurt, fall, lie), UFE 2's 3D demo characters are unarmed and its Ellen is a 2D sprite. Picked from the 13 of a08_sword_candidates.json (out/a08_sword_candidates.mp4): three of Vindictus' sword combo (Fiona's game; none of the four Fiona strikes with herself, vdf_fiona.json, so the two do not mirror each other) and the big cut in Inase's own skill_01. A Attack02 a diagonal cut, B Attack03 a low sweep, C Attack04 the sword over the head and down into the ground, D the wheel cut of her skill_01 (knocks down). Each kept up to where the swing has settled ("to"; the game's clips take 2-2.7 s back to idle) and hits while the blade's tip sweeps through the front ("hit", from RoeMotionPacks.Import -roeTips: the tip ahead of her and fast; measured on a08 with the grip). C and D are Mid by hand (measured at the tip's farthest point the slam ends on the ground - Low - and the wheel high - High; both are blocked standing). Her grip: tools/roe/a08_grip.json (RoeWeaponGrip). who / src / zh are notes for people and the videos.
source: Vindictus: Defying Fate 2024-03 pre-alpha (Fiona's AnimSequences, Assets/VDF/fio005/anims); Rise of Eros (a08 skill_01)
